title: The Deep Deadline
author: Marguerite Eriksen
blurb: Dominic Amberdale, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, has spent seven years following rules that keep getting rewritten. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
